title: Work, Energy and Power — Quick Quiz

questions.q: What is the area under a Force vs. Displacement (F-x) graph equal to?
questions.explanation: The definite integral ∫ F dx represents the area under the F-x curve, which equals work done.

questions.q: In a perfectly elastic collision, which of the following is conserved?
questions.explanation: Elastic collisions strictly preserve both linear momentum and kinetic energy.

questions.q: If two bodies of masses m₁ and m₂ (m₁ > m₂) have equal kinetic energy, which body has greater momentum?
questions.explanation: Since p = √(2m E_k), momentum is directly proportional to √m when E_k is constant.

questions.q: What is the coefficient of restitution (e) for a perfectly inelastic collision?
questions.explanation: In a perfectly inelastic collision, bodies move together with zero relative velocity after impact (v₂ = v₁), so e = 0.

questions.q: A force of 10 N acts on a body moving with velocity 5 m/s at an angle of 60° to the force. What is the power?
questions.explanation: Power P = F v cosθ = 10 × 5 × cos(60°) = 50 × 0.5 = 25 Watts.
